description: One-call website security audit with a 0-100 score, A-F grade and plain-English summary. Real, non-intrusive checks: TLS certificate (validity, expiry, issuer, protocol, hostname match), HTTP->HTTPS redirect, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), cookie flags, exposed sensitive files (/.git, /.env, config backups, phpinfo, server-status, directory listing), server/version disclosure, DNS (A/AAAA/MX/NS/CAA, DNSSEC), email spoofing protection (SPF, DMARC policy, common DKIM selectors) and CMS/version detection. Every finding has a severity and a fix. ~20 s max, light GET requests only. Returns JSON with: domain, score, grade, summary, counts, findings, tls, http. Price: $0.05 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/site-security-audit
